history.summary: THIS IS A CHRISTIAN CHURCH, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE. Solomon's Temple in the Kidron Valley at Chawlhhmun, about 10 km west of Aizawl, is a church built by Kohhran Thianghlim ('The Holy Church'), a non-denominational indigenous church founded by Dr. L.B. Sailo in 1984, whose members are known as 'the elects'. Sailo said that in 1991 God showed him Solomon's Temple in a dream; he sketched it from the dream on waking. The foundation stone was laid on 23 December 1996 (some sources say 25 December), and construction took about 20 years, finishing in 2017 when the church was inaugurated with a Christmas service (verify exact date). It is one of the largest churches in Mizoram: the square site measures 180 ft on each side, the main hall (120 ft square) seats about 2,000 people (some sources say 3,000), and the courtyard, the 'porch of Solomon's Temple', accommodates about 10,000. Distinctive architecture includes white marble exteriors (imported Rajasthan marble), four towers each topped with a crown, Star of David motifs, walls facing the cardinal directions, 32 windows, 32 ventilations and 32 skylights, and four pillars above the porch carrying seven David's stars representing the seven churches of Revelation (verify details). It is a major tourist attraction in Aizawl as well as a place of worship.

name: Solomon's Temple
town_description: Aizawl is the capital and largest city of Mizoram, set on a ridge at about 1,132 m with the Tlawng river valley to its west and the Tuirial valley to its east. It is a predominantly Christian city where Christmas (Krismas) is the biggest festival, and churches are the centres of community life. Visitors to Mizoram need an Inner Line Permit (ILP); the city is well connected by air via Lengpui Airport and by the new Bairabi-Sairang railway line (Sairang station, about 17 km away).

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (AJL), about 22 km from Aizawl; the temple at Kidron Valley/Chawlhhmun is about 10 km west of Aizawl city (verify). Taxis available.
travel.railway: Sairang Railway Station, about 17 km from Aizawl, on the new Bairabi-Sairang line (inaugurated September 2025; Rajdhani to Delhi, tri-weekly to Kolkata, daily Mizoram Express to Guwahati); Bairabi station about 100 km (verify).
travel.road: Kidron Valley, Chawlhhmun, on the western outskirts of Aizawl, about 10 km from the city centre; reachable by local bus (Chawlhhmun stop) plus shared taxi, or by taxi from Aizawl.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for cool, clear weather. Christmas season (December) is the most festive time but crowded; Mizoram requires an Inner Line Permit for visitors from other Indian states.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Tourist visiting hours per Aizawl district website: Monday to Saturday, winter (October-February) 10:00 AM-4:00 PM, summer (March-September) 10:00 AM-5:00 PM (verify).
